NP Presspad 1.4.1 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

## Dependency updates

- **Rich text editor (Tiptap)** 3.32.2 → 3.33.0 — the editor at the heart of writing and formatting your posts, with the latest upstream fixes; all `@tiptap/*` packages moved together.
- **Electron** 45.2.1 → 45.2.3 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime), with the latest fixes from the Electron 45 line.
- **Styling (Tailwind CSS)** 4.3.3 → 4.3.5 — the engine behind the interface's look and layout.
- **Lucide icons** 1.66.0 → 1.70.0 — the icon set used across the interface.
- **Markdown parser (marked)** 18.1.2 → 18.1.3 — used when rendering and converting content to Markdown.
- **HTML-to-Markdown converter (turndown)** 7.2.4 → 7.2.5 — used when bringing existing post content into the editor.
- **Build & test tooling** — Vite 8.3.5 → 8.3.6, the React build plugin 6.1.2 → 6.2.1, and the Vitest test runner 5.0.5 → 5.1.0. Development tooling only; none of it ships in the app.
